label: Kashmir Śaivism (non-dual Śaiva tantra of Kashmir)
text: c. 850 CE (Vasugupta, Kallaṭa) - 11th c. classical period (Utpaladeva, Abhinavagupta, Kṣemarāja); commentarial and devotional continuation to the 18th-19th c.; revived in the 20th c.

label: Spanda (the doctrine of vibration)
text: c. 850-900 CE (Vasugupta and Kallaṭa; Kallaṭa is placed under King Avantivarman, 855-883, by the Rājataraṅgiṇī); commentaries to Kṣemarāja (c. 1000-1050) and later.

label: Pratyabhijñā (the philosophy of recognition)
text: Somānanda c. 900-950; Utpaladeva c. 925-975; Abhinavagupta's Vimarśinī dated Laukika 90 (c. 1014/15 CE); Kṣemarāja c. 1000-1050.
